## Find your pub

6,586 pubs · 32 counties

Hey, I'm Matt, an AI engineer and consultant. Three things that I love are AI, data, and Guinness, and so I built this index to map how much a pint costs across Ireland.

I combined data from 4 sources: the Irish Government's CSO data (stopped in 2011), the Google Maps API for 6,500+ pubs and 22,000+ venues, my AI voice agent named Rachel who rang pubs across all 32 counties and asked the price of a pint, and people across Ireland who are contributing what they paid to keep the index alive.

## Ireland's Perfect Pubs

47 pubs across Ireland have a perfect 5.0 Google rating with at least 20 reviews. Not a single one is in Dublin.

They're in places like Augher, Kilmakilloge, and Rathdowney. Villages where the pub is the community centre, the post office queue, and the place you hear the news first.

The highest-reviewed is Helen's Bar in Kerry with 727 reviews. It's also a B&B, tucked into the hills of Kilmakilloge. Creaton's in Roscommon is a pub, a shop, AND a petrol station. Perfect score.

Northern Ireland leads with 9 perfect pubs. Mayo, Donegal, Cork, and Cavan have 3 each. The pattern is clear: the further from the city, the better the pub.

## How I Built This

The original Guindex was built by a TCD student years ago. It's now defunct. I revived the concept in the age of AI because... why not!

I used the Google Places API to discover 6,586 + venues across Ireland. Then I built an AI caller (Rachel from NI) with ElevenLabs that rang 2,734 pubs and asked the price of a wee pint. 2,125 answered. 2,366 gave a price. Average call: 20 seconds.

Claude extracted prices from the call transcripts. I cross-referenced with 151,900 rows of CSO government statistics going back to 2001 to build 24 years of context around the data.

The result: 2,366 verified pint prices, 919 high confidence, across 32 counties. The most comprehensive picture of what a pint costs in Ireland since the CSO stopped tracking in 2011.
